subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: The next morning, the party negotiated with Tappy Foamstrap

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: After several hours of excavation

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: rock blight caverns entrance
fact: The entrance to the rock blight caverns was reached after several hours of excavation.
source_quote: After several hours of excavation, they successfully reached the entrance to the rock blight caverns.

subject: protective crystal count
fact: The party collected several protective crystals of different colors for potential future use.
source_quote: The party collected several protective crystals of different colors for potential future use, though they learned the colors themselves didn't affect the magical properties.

subject: gem value
fact: Six valuable gems worth six hundred gold pieces each and a potion of invisibility were found beneath the stone bed.
source_quote: containing six valuable gems worth six hundred gold pieces each and a potion of invisibility.

subject: ghost identification
fact: The skeletal remains were identified as belonging to Udhask, one of the ghosts Burrow Warden Jadger had asked them to rescue.
source_quote: They identified the skeletal remains as belonging to Udhask, one of the ghosts that Burrow Warden Jadger had asked them to rescue.

subject: statue animation
fact: Two winged statues animated into gargoyles that immediately attacked.
source_quote: the statues animated into gargoyles that immediately attacked.

subject: earth elemental emergence
fact: A crazed earth elemental suddenly erupted from the ground, confirming earlier warnings.
source_quote: a crazed earth elemental suddenly erupted from the ground, confirming the earlier warnings that earth elementals in the area had been driven mad.

subject: stream and staircase elevation
fact: A shallow, swiftly flowing stream led thirty feet up to a barren stone ledge.
source_quote: a shallow, swiftly flowing stream with crystalline formations and rough-hewn staircases leading thirty feet up to a barren stone ledge.

subject: gargoyle battle outcome
fact: The second gargoyle charged at Grygum, biting and clawing him viciously for significant wounds.
source_quote: The second gargoyle charged at Grygum, biting and clawing him viciously for significant wounds.

subject: spoil booze quantity
fact: Barrels of spoiled booze were acquired to use as weapons against oozes.
source_quote: the party negotiated with Tappy Foamstrap to acquire barrels of spoiled booze to use as weapons against oozes

subject: myconoid wedding observation
fact: A deep gnome scout shared a bizarre tale of encountering dancing myconoids who spoke of attending a wedding celebration.
source_quote: A deep gnome scout shared a bizarre tale of encountering dancing myconoids who spoke of attending a wedding celebration, which was highly unusual since myconoids don't typically marry or celebrate.

subject: ghost attack description
fact: A ghost of a deep gnome appeared and attacked them in a pissed-off fury, shouting 'They're coming! Everyone must hide!'
source_quote: a ghost of a deep gnome appeared and attacked them in a pissed-off fury. Zalthir engaged the spirit with his fists, landing powerful blows that caused the ghost to shout 'They're coming! Everyone must hide!' before becoming visibly frightened.

subject: cavern illumination
fact: A dark cavern was illuminated by bioluminescent fungi that refracted through large crystal formations, creating a kaleidoscope of colors on the surrounding walls.
source_quote: The party entered a dark cavern illuminated by bioluminescent fungi that refracted through large crystal formations, creating a kaleidoscope of colors on the surrounding walls.

subject: crystal statue description
fact: A stone statue of a gnome cowering near a crystal outgrowth held a broken crystal to its face as if trying to look through it.
source_quote: They discovered a stone statue of a gnome cowering near a crystal outgrowth, holding a broken crystal to its face as if trying to look through it.

subject: gelatinous cube singing
fact: Glabbagool became intoxicated from consuming spilled alcohol while cleaning the tavern floor, leading to the gelatinous cube singing sea shanties in a voice that made everyone question their life choices.
source_quote: Glabbagool became intoxicated from consuming spilled alcohol while cleaning the tavern floor, leading to the gelatinous cube singing sea shanties in a voice that made everyone question their life choices.

subject: cavern mirroring Blingdenstone
fact: The caverns mirrored Blingdenstone's residential areas but were filled with signs of carnage.
source_quote: As they explored deeper into the caverns that mirrored Blingdenstone's residential areas but were filled with signs of carnage

subject: burrow location
fact: The ghost fled into a burrow, with the adventurers pursuing close behind.
source_quote: The ghost turned ethereal and fled into a burrow, with the adventurers pursuing close behind.

subject: stone bed compartment
fact: A hidden compartment beneath the stone bed contained six valuable gems and a potion of invisibility.
source_quote: A hidden compartment beneath the bed containing six valuable gems worth six hundred gold pieces each and a potion of invisibility.

subject: gargoyle battle sequence
fact: Zalthir engaged one gargoyle in melee combat, landing multiple devastating punches; Daz attempted magic that resisted; Thorin finished it with darts.
source_quote: Zalthir engaged one gargoyle in melee combat, landing multiple devastating punches. Daz attempted to use his magic against the injured gargoyle, but it resisted the spell's full effect. Thorin moved closer and threw darts at the flying creature, finishing it off despite its supernatural resistance to mundane weapons.

subject: earth elemental confirmation
fact: The eruption of the crazed earth elemental confirmed earlier warnings about mad earth elementals in the area.
source_quote: a crazed earth elemental suddenly erupted from the ground, confirming the earlier warnings that earth elementals in the area had been driven mad.
